1.e4 d6 2.d4 Nf6 3.Nc3 Nbd7 4.f4 e5 5.Nf.strategy: Recaptures with the queen, which is centralised and hits the f6-knight and the d6 and a7 pawns at once. White keeps the lead in development and space, but the exposed queen can be harassed, so White must keep playing actively.

Takes b5 and d5 away from White's pieces: no bishop pinning the d7-knight, no knight jumping to b5 to hit d6. It takes the sting out of White's active pieces and lets Black finish development quietly, though White keeps a small initiative.
